fills.researcher_notes: Per-COMPANY merger question (gotcha 4): Energy Transfer completed its acquisition of Enable Midstream Partners on 2021-12-02. The gem.wiki candidate value ('Enable Gas Transmission LLC') just repeats the current Owner cell -- it answers 'what is the pipeline subsidiary called', not 'who operates it now', so I did not carry it across. Two independent, current sources instead: (1) Natural Gas Intelligence (trade press, independent of both companies), reporting the week the merger closed: 'Dallas-based Energy Transfer LP owns and operates another 14,000 miles of natural gas and oil pipeline in Arkansas, Louisiana, Oklahoma and Texas after completing its merger' with Enable -- Enable Gas Transmission's ~5,900-mile interstate system is part of that mileage. (2) A 2024 FERC Federal Register notice filed by 'Enable Gas Transmission, LLC' under its blanket authorization directs inquiries to the Senior Director of Certificates AT Energy Transfer -- i.e., three years post-merger, EGT's own FERC regulatory contact is Energy Transfer's certificates office, not a standalone Enable office. Predecessor operator (pre-2021-12-02): Enable Midstream Partners, LP. Recorded as 'Energy Transfer' per the tracker's existing short-form convention for this company elsewhere on the operators/owners tab. Operator is written 'Energy Transfer' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Energy Transfer LP'.
